title: new and set agree on a trivial repro or check: new refuses what set and check refuse as trivial_command
goal: Found at the SP-uzwbt63u review: after ST-webfvbcb, new story --check 'python3 -c "print(1)"' exits 0 with a warning while set --check of the same command exits 2 and backlog check then errors on the item (trivial_command), so a filed item can still fail the landing gate; ST-webfvbcb's gate g3 kept new's warning because test_backlog_portable.py files python3 -c pass through new. new refuses a trivial command with exit 2 and nothing written, as set does, and the portable test files a non-trivial check

run: import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile; live = os.getcwd(); t = tempfile.mkdtemp(); subprocess.run(['git', 'init', '-q', t], check=True); d = t + '/kb/_self/backlog'; os.makedirs(d); p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, live + '/_tools/backlog.py', '--root', t, 'new', 'story', '--title', 'S', '--goal', 'g', '--check', 'python3 -c "print(1)"'], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=t); sys.exit(0 if p.returncode == 2 and os.listdir(d) == [] else 1)
